author: Gavin (gmarcialcalleja)
summary: Implement capped two-channel scheduler with simulated outputs
details: Add independent expiry, no backlog or active-pulse extension, original local eligibility deadlines, per-channel pulse/minimum-off/rolling duty limits, sticky fault shutdown and startup/cleanup off requests. Only simulated outputs are shipped; physical driver integration awaits CS-009. No observation-to-cue policy, GPIO or electrical verification.
validation: 38 edge tests passed on Windows/Linux Python 3.12 (25 scheduler plus 13 uploader), including five simulated minutes of adversarial requests and independent real worker cleanup. Simulation ends with both outputs off and gpio_used false. Checked publishing runs shared/repository/changelog/whitespace checks.
